title: Choose Whisker Commons' mobile visual world
question: Choose the world that should carry Nearby, cat identity, reporting and care continuity across the app.

options.label: Sheltered Link Atlas
options.lineage: Singapore estate directories, covered-linkway maps and maintenance wayfinding
options.thesis: The neighbourhood is a legible safety atlas, with community cats appearing as living places rather than social-media cards.
options.viewport: A coarse-area atlas fills the upper half; a single selected cat and its latest safe activity rise in a compact anchored sheet above a translucent native tab bar.
options.risk: The map grammar can feel civic or infrastructural unless cat photography and care language keep it humane.

raised.raise: One-pixel rules and keyed state marks make dense activity scannable without card stacks.
Stale and interrupted data receive one unmistakable seam instead of another warning box.
Every time and freshness phase is named and patterned, never carried by colour alone.

options.label: Care Handover Ledger
options.lineage: volunteer shift handovers, clinic observation sheets and field notebooks
options.thesis: Every sighting becomes a concise handover note that another neighbour can understand and continue.
options.viewport: A dense but calm latest-activity ledger leads with a real cat portrait, followed by ruled handover rows, one follow action and a persistent report control.
options.risk: This is the most familiar and operationally clear direction, so weak execution could slide back into generic editorial UI.

options.label: Neighbourhood Field Poster
options.lineage: WPA national-park travel posters translated into Singapore community-cat field guides
options.thesis: Each coarse area is a bold field plate where one cat, one care status and one next action own the screen.
options.viewport: A full-bleed cat-and-estate field plate sits above a block-caption identity strip, with compact safe-area facts and one action instead of a feed of cards.
options.case: It wins audience warmth and memorability while preserving a clear discovery action, but carries less information density than the assigned atlas.
options.risk: It can become tourism nostalgia or illustration-first decoration if the status system does not stay operational.

options.label: Reference Rail
options.lineage: reference-setting pages drawn by a ruling engine
options.thesis: Identity evidence is arranged around one fixed provenance rail.
options.viewport: Two short columns surround a keyed identity rail with evidence annotations in the margin.
options.case: Strong information discipline, but too text-centric for a quick outdoor discovery screen.
options.kept: Exact ruling and printed state marks.
options.risk: Reads like an archival review tool instead of a neighbour-facing mobile app.

options.label: Depot Blind
options.lineage: destination blinds and stitched depot rolls
options.thesis: Updates step through a fixed window and faults stop visibly at one seam.
options.viewport: A fixed status window shows one cat update while an eyelet index changes area.
options.case: Excellent stale/error language, but poor fit for photos, maps and flexible report content.
options.kept: One explicit seam for interrupted or stale state.
options.risk: The transit metaphor would overpower care and identity.

options.label: Seven-Segment Commons
options.lineage: scoreboards, bedside clocks and public price totems
options.thesis: Delayed activity occupies a rigid mask where active and unavailable states are equally designed.
options.viewport: A fixed grid shows safe time buckets, area and identity state as illuminated cells.
options.case: Clear state transitions, but too machine-like for care and too rigid for bilingual copy.
options.kept: Inactive and unavailable states are designed, not left blank.
options.risk: Feels like monitoring infrastructure rather than a community commons.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Activity paths reveal how a coarse area relates without implying an exact route.
options.viewport: One dominant area field bends delayed activity toward a selected cat while a level legend explains the safe abstraction.
options.case: The causal map is expressive, but simulation and motion would obscure the fast outdoor task.
options.kept: Directional relationships remain visible without revealing a route.
options.risk: High motion cost and weak platform familiarity.

options.label: Dawn Cue Commons
options.thesis: Freshness and care status move through named atmospheric phases.
options.viewport: A selected cat stands against a banded freshness horizon with a scrubbable but text-equivalent cue timeline.
options.case: Powerful phase language, but dark theatrical atmosphere lowers everyday trust and map clarity.
options.kept: Named freshness phases with pattern equivalents.
options.risk: The dramatic light world is too distant from daily neighbourhood use.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished pet-community feed with white cards, soft green accents and photo-led profiles.
canonCard.viewport: A heading, privacy notice and vertical stack of cat cards above a conventional bottom tab bar.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, but intentionally indistinguishable from the category and close to the current AI-like baseline.
